! RKS CAM-B3LYP def2-TZVP NoAutoStart
%maxcore 192
%pal nprocs 4 end
%scf MaxIter 256 AutoTRAH false end
%tddft NRoots 5 TDA false Triplets false MaxIter 128 end
* xyzfile 0 1 geom.xyz
parameters.name: acetone_tddft.inp
tddft_analysis.py

entries.purpose: initial prepared acetone geometry for vertical TDDFT
ORCA TDDFT response output to parse
initial prepared geometry used for the single-point vertical TDDFT

proposal.reason: Resolve and prepare the acetone system, write an explicit full linear-response TDDFT input (CAM-B3LYP/def2-TZVP, TDA false, NRoots 5), run ORCA, then parse the archived response into complete five-root energies and length-form oscillator strengths plus delivery artifacts. The analysis script is written as a workspace artifact and referenced by producer port, avoiding the rejected omitted-hash reference.
